findings.message:
Repair is not used by the runtime

No repository code imports this new module; runtime uses `src/sentinel/replay-retention.ts`, whose resume path still infers the claim kind from the current time. Thus the requested resumed-eviction behavior remains unfixed.

src/sentinel_replay_retention.ts:1282-1287

Added module has unresolved imports

These relative imports target `src/sentinel_replay_capture.ts` and `src/sentinel_replay_limits.ts`, neither of which exists in the candidate tree. The module cannot be loaded if it is wired in without also correcting these paths.

src/sentinel_replay_retention.ts:34-55

summary: The added repair is not wired into the active retention implementation and imports nonexistent modules.

evidence: The candidate adds claim_kind persistence in the new module, but no runtime code imports that module; the active src/sentinel/replay-retention.ts still derives the resumed kind from expires_at_ms <= nowMs.
The new module's relative capture and limits imports do not resolve in the candidate tree, so it cannot provide the required working fixture behavior.
